admission.justification: Running a diagnostic inside the live checkout can alter the reviewed candidate; scratch-only checking and the supplied report address prevent that error.

applicability: Investigator evidence gathering and report delivery.
conditions: Checks run only in scratch or the repository tooling sandbox.
The report path, actual launch parent and reporting role/task address come from the handover.
A replacement occupant may receive the ordinary report return without changing fixed launch-parent identity or the actual-parent-ID developer-question channel.
exclusions: Changes to a code checkout, leaf enclosure, memory or task state.

evidence: E9 native Investigator report and Manager read-back in .e9.tar.gz

statement: The Investigator reads source and context, runs checks only in scratch or a repository-tooling sandbox, writes the named report and returns its path to the supplied parent role/task reporting address; initial concern and developer-question provenance remain the actual starter.
